description: This file defines utility functions for error handling and validation error management in a JavaScript project, exporting functions throwError and handleValidationErrors.

methods.name: throwError
methods.description: Creates and throws an Error object with a specified status code and message, removing the stack trace.

methods.name: handleValidationErrors
methods.description: Asynchronously validates data against a schema, logs validation errors, and throws a formatted error if validation fails.
